Program Starts at Range Air Fry 385°F 180–400°F Roast 380°F 180–400°F Bake 365°F 180–400°F Broil 400°F 350–400°F Reheat 280°F 120–360°F Dehydrate 130°F 95–175°F The Turn Food prompt Take chicken thighs roasted at 425°F for 35 minutes. On a Vortex Plus they convert to 400°F for 28 minutes, checked from minute 20. Flip them around minute 14. Air Fry and Roast show Turn Food partway through; pull the basket, turn, and slide it back. If you miss the prompt, cooking resumes after 10 seconds, so set a phone timer for the flip if you will be away. Broil and Dehydrate do not prompt a turn, and Reheat starts without preheating, so it shows no Add Food step. Use the ClearCook window, not the basket On ClearCook models, press Light and check browning through the window. Every time you pull the basket the chamber cools and the Vortex has to recover, which stretches the time. Open it for the turn and for the final check, not in between. Models without a window give you no way to look in, so trust the converted time: open the basket once for the turn and once at the check time the converter shows. Vortex programs and their limits Air Fry on the Vortex Plus 6-quart starts at 385°F and goes to 400°F. Broil runs from 350°F to 400°F, and Reheat stops at 360°F. When you convert an oven recipe, use Air Fry or Roast and set the converted temperature yourself; Reheat cannot reach a full cooking setting. Models with Plus in the name go down to 95°F for dehydrating. The plain Vortex starts higher, which only matters for drying fruit or jerky. Related Chicken thighs 380°F · 24 min · flip at 12 Salmon 390°F · 9 min Leftover pizza 350°F · 4 min Oven to air fryer converter → Ninja air fryer conversion → Cosori air fryer conversion → Philips Airfryer conversion → Frequently asked questions What is the maximum temperature on an Instant Vortex? Air Fry goes up to 400°F (205°C) on every Vortex in our table. The dual-zone models broil higher, to 450°F, but Air Fry still stops at 400°F. What happens if I ignore Turn Food? The Vortex waits 10 seconds and then keeps cooking without the turn. Food that needed flipping will be browner on top than underneath. Does the Instant Vortex preheat? Yes. Air Fry, Roast and Bake show Preheating first and then Add Food when it is ready. Reheat skips the preheat. Can I check food without opening the basket? On ClearCook models, turn on the light and look through the window. Opening the basket cools the chamber and adds time. Do I convert differently for the VersaZone or Dual models? Convert each food on its own, since each zone runs its own setting. Their Air Fry limit is the same 400°F as the single-basket models.
